_comment: Re-authentication proofs for POST /api/account/deletion and the challenge they must carry. Tokens are placeholders: tests mock the ID-token verifier and feed it the decoded claims below. No real subjects, emails or keys.
_usage: Use in delete-account.feature and partial-failure.feature. 'now' is the test clock; ages are seconds before now. The guest_* cases belong to a guest account (no users row); their secrets and hashes are example values of auth.guest-account, where the hash is SHA-256 hex of the secret.

challenge._comment: Response of POST /api/account/deletion/challenge, issued to the session of user-001.

google_valid._comment: Fresh sign-in by the account owner; carries the issued nonce.

google_other_subject._comment: Valid token for a different Google account than the signed-in user: expect 403 wrong_account.

google_stale._comment: Same subject, but older than ACCOUNT_DELETION_REAUTH_MAX_AGE_SECONDS (300): expect 401 reauth_required.

apple_valid_with_code._comment: Fresh Apple sign-in including the one-time authorization code used for token revocation. The issuer value is Apple's documented one; verify it against current Apple documentation.

guest_valid._comment: A guest presents its active device credential again together with the issued challenge. There is no token, so there are no decoded claims: the verifier hashes the secret and looks the hash up among the active device credentials of the session's account.

guest_wrong_secret._comment: A secret whose hash matches no active device credential of the account: expect 401 reauth_required, nothing deleted, the nonce still unused.

revoke_request_identity_toolkit._comment: Shape of the revocation call the origin app sends for an Apple account (Firebase Identity Toolkit). Method POST, URL https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com/v2/accounts:revokeToken with the project web API key as query parameter 'key' (omitted here).
